title: Ultherapy Cost in Dubai and How Long It Lasts
h1: Ultherapy cost in Dubai and how long the results last
desc: Ultherapy prices in Dubai: face or neck AED 7,000 + VAT, face and neck AED 10,000 + VAT, how long results last and how it compares with HIFU and Ultraformer MPT.
answer: At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina, Ultherapy costs AED 7,000 + VAT for the face, AED 7,000 + VAT for the neck and AED 10,000 + VAT for face and neck, usually in a single session. The lift builds over 2 to 3 months and lasts a year or more for many people, so most book a top-up every 12 to 18 months.
facts: A year or more for many people
body:
## What the price covers

Ultherapy is priced per area for a single session. The price includes real-time ultrasound imaging, which lets the practitioner see the skin's layers on screen and place the energy at the right depth. That imaging is the main reason Ultherapy costs more than standard HIFU. It has US FDA clearance for lifting the brow, neck and under-chin area and improving lines on the chest.

## Prices by area

- **Face:** AED 7,000 + VAT
- **Neck:** AED 7,000 + VAT
- **Face and neck:** AED 10,000 + VAT, which saves AED 4,000 compared with booking both separately
- **Body, per area:** AED 7,000 + VAT

## How long it lasts

The lift appears gradually over 2 to 3 months as new collagen forms, and many people keep a visible improvement for a year or more. Ageing continues, so most people plan a top-up every 12 to 18 months. Spread over that time, face and neck works out at roughly AED 550 to 850 + VAT a month.

## Ultherapy, HIFU or Ultraformer MPT?

- **[Ultherapy](/treatments/ultherapy-dubai/):** imaging-guided, AED 7,000 + VAT face or neck.
- **[Ultraformer III HIFU](/treatments/hifu-dubai/):** no imaging, faster and more affordable, AED 5,000 + VAT face or neck.
- **[Ultraformer MPT](/treatments/ultraformer-mpt-dubai/):** newer HIFU designed for comfort, AED 7,000 + VAT face or neck.

All three lift and tighten mild to moderate laxity. See [Ultherapy vs HIFU](/blog/ultherapy-vs-hifu/) and [HIFU price in Dubai](/blog/hifu-price-dubai/).

## Who gets the most for the money

Ultherapy suits people with early to moderate sagging of the brow, jawline and neck who want a natural lift without downtime. It is less suited to very loose, hanging skin, where surgery changes more. Your doctor confirms whether Ultherapy, HIFU or a gradual option such as [radiofrequency](/blog/ultherapy-vs-radiofrequency/) gives you the best result for your budget.
